description: List DHCPv6 clients on a MikroTik router: what each requests (address and/or prefix), its status, the delegated prefix and the pool it fills, and whether it adds a default route or uses the peer's DNS. Supports filtering by interface and status, with pagination.

interface.description: Only the client on this interface

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

status.description: Only clients in this state, e.g. bound, searching, requesting, stopped

name: list_dhcpv6_clients
title: List DHCPv6 Clients
